# Exponents & Logs

**Exponent laws**

$$
a^{m+n}=a^ma^n \qquad a^{m-n}=\frac{a^m}{a^n} \qquad (a^m)^n=a^{mn}
$$

**Useful forms**

$$
a^{2n}=(a^n)^2 \qquad a^{n+1}=a\cdot a^n
$$

**Log laws**

$$
\ln(ab)=\ln a+\ln b \qquad \ln\frac ab=\ln a-\ln b \qquad \ln(a^r)=r\ln a
$$

**Key value**

$$
\ln 1=0
$$

**Warning**

$$
\ln(a+b)\ne\ln a+\ln b
$$
